This is the USB-C of AI.
Welcome to Agent School — lesson sixteen.
Today's problem: every app needed its own custom tool code.
MCP — the Model Context Protocol — fixes that.
Anthropic released it as an open standard in late 2024.
Remember drawers full of different chargers?
USB-C made one plug fit everything.
MCP does that for AI tools.
Build an MCP server once — for your calendar, your database, your files — and any AI app that speaks MCP can plug into it.
OpenAI, Google and many others added support.
A plug that fits everything also needs care: only connect servers you trust, and give them the least access they need.
